additional_info.subject: 0367713 - ID0367713-DC/Si-D/NL[BszIkS] - HMI is black CRM:00315001571
additional_info.body:
Hi Thomas, good morning.
After yesterday's site visit, we were able to identify that the HMI was faulty.
Here is a short summary of our performed actions:
Check the XD24:4 for 24V (input point for 24V HMI)
We have 24.66V → okay
Next, we measured directly on the connector that provides the 24V to the HMI :
We measure again 24.6 V → okay
Before we opened the metal plate to verify the PCB directly (which takes sometime and work), we tried replacing the USB and DP cable:
No result
We measured at the output of the connector and we have 24V (couldn't take a photo).
Tried removing and reinsert the connector and turning OFF and ON the FC14 → still same result.
Problem can't be the FC14 otherwise we would have problem in, e.g, routers, and also the connector was tested from both sides to see if it wasn't a connector issue.
Check the LED of the HMI and it's not turning ON as it's supposed to.
Solution: replace the HMI.
Please proceed to order a new HMI and replace it.
If there are no further questions I will close the ticket since we only need to replace the HMI now.
I just need you to help me filling this in after you replace the HMI for QM:
Defective part name/MLFB: HMI gen1?
Component serial number:
Logs with marked error (CSV format preferred): N/A
Active error flags before replacement: None
Device-specific error code
(if applicable): No LED turned ON
Outcome of wiring checkup: Checked connections from XD21:4 onwards until the PCB of the HMI, all the connectors had 24V. Tried replacing USB and DP cable, and also didn't work.
Commissioning checklist
Commissioning date
Field service report
Date of failure
(see side note): This week?
I will close the ticket. When you have all this information when you replace it, please just reply to this email and ignore the auto response.
Thank you very much!
Best regards,
Francisco
